scope: Two potentially consequential September 1–2 releases that were initially marked pending in the source-selection packet. This record preserves the limited verified scope; it is not independent editorial admission.

records.verifiedExcerpt: NVIDIA has agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12,930,300,000. Hugging Face will remain an open platform for the entire AI ecosystem. NVIDIA compute will not be required to build on or deploy through Hugging Face.
records.readerScope: An announced acquisition, not a completed transaction. The open-platform and compute-neutral statements are NVIDIA commitments, not independently verified future behaviour.

records.verifiedExcerpt: Gemini 3.8 Flash generally available (GA): Released gemini-3.8-flash, our most intelligent Flash model, engineered for long-horizon software engineering, autonomous agents, and complex enterprise workflows.
records.readerScope: A developer/API model release. This source does not establish consumer ChatGPT-like availability, pricing, regional access, or independent performance claims.

records.verifiedExcerpt: Today, we’re introducing a new electronic health record integration that brings authorized patient context from Epic into ChatGPT for Healthcare, along with the Healthcare Public Data plugin for direct, structured access to official healthcare datasets like PubMed, DailyMed, and CMS Coverage.
records.readerScope: This is an organizational healthcare-product announcement. The accompanying OpenAI Help release notes say the public-data plugin is read-only and does not access patient charts; Epic access requires an administrator-configured app, an individual Epic sign-in, and existing patient-chart permissions. It does not establish personal consumer availability or clinical-outcome benefit.

limitations: The Google source is a provider release note; independent performance comparison remains outside this bounded source capture.
